subject: Judge E: DAG-only injected context at claim (drop RAG-fill tier; keep search_knowledge as explicit tool)
description:
When a worker claims a task, its AUTO-INJECTED context is the judged DAG neighborhood ONLY — no retrieval-time RAG-fill tier. Safe BECAUSE tasks A–D guarantee the DAG is complete-and-judged at claim time (eager judgment + ready-gate remove the staleness boundary). Part of the eager-judgment-lifecycle redesign.

DESIGN:
1. Collapse the two-tier retrieval at claim/injection: drop the RAG-fill tier; inject only the task's judged context_deps (the DAG neighborhood). The DAG is now the compiled/judged RAG, so re-running raw RAG at consumption only adds unjudged noise.
2. KEEP search_knowledge as an EXPLICIT agent tool (fork 3 default — TUNABLE): only the AUTO-injected context is DAG-only; a worker that reasons it needs out-of-neighborhood info can still call search_knowledge deliberately. Do NOT remove that tool — that would kill discovery of anything not pre-wired.
3. Document the invariant: DAG-only auto-context is correct ONLY under the ready-gate guarantee (task D). If the gate is bypassed/disabled, fall back to two-tier.

TEST: a claimed task's injected context contains only judged DAG edges (no rag-tier entries); search_knowledge still callable and returns results; an unjudged-flagged task (timeout fallback) still gets its (flagged) context.

GUARDRAIL: blocked by D — DAG-only is only safe once the ready-gate guarantees a complete judged DAG.
